We've made some noteworthy improvements to this long-standing favorite, such as Japanese adzuki beans (higher in protein), carefully seasoned extra-lean ground beef, guacamole, sour cream, fresh tomatoes, lettuce, and two kinds of cheese all rolled up in a soft wheat chapati. The Good Earth's interpretation - beautiful combination of Japanese adzuki beans and pinto beans on a crisp whole wheat chapati, topped with cheeses and seasoned extra-lean ground beef, then mounded high with shredded lettuce, guacamole, cucumbers, tomato slices, sprouts, and sour cream. Served with a side of our homemade salsa
